title: A Walk in the Park
text:
Tom likes nature. Every Sunday he goes to a big park near his house. There are many tall trees and green grass. Tom often sees birds and squirrels there.

One day Tom saw a small pond. Some ducks were swimming in the water. He threw bread to them and they ate it. Tom wants to keep the park clean, so he always takes his rubbish home with him.

questions.text: Where does Tom go every Sunday?
options: To a big park near his house

questions.text: What did Tom throw to the ducks?
Why does Tom take his rubbish home?
options: He wants to keep the park clean
He has no bin at home
He is afraid of the ducks

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel about nature?
options: He does not care about it

vocabulary.definition: a large public garden with grass and trees
things you throw away because you do not need them

paragraph_translations: Tom lubi przyrodę. Każdej niedzieli chodzi do dużego parku w pobliżu swojego domu. Są tam wysokie drzewa i zielona trawa. Tom często widzi tam ptaki i wiewiórki.
Pewnego dnia Tom zobaczył mały staw. W wodzie pływały kaczki. Rzucał im chleb, a one go jadły. Tom chce, żeby park był czysty, dlatego zawsze zabiera swoje śmieci do domu.
